name: Smaug-Agentic
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from moonshotai/Kimi-K3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1048576). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated MLA on 24 layers + Kimi Delta Attention on 69 layers, with Attention Residuals
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A supervised finetune of moonshotai/Kimi-K3 by Abacus.AI, not a new base model: the card states the architecture is unchanged (same 2.8T MoE, same 1M context, same MoonViT-V2 encoder, same tokenizer); safetensors total 2,779,932,000,000 elements (2.779932e12), which round-trips to the base record's 2,780B label. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-08-10. CAVEATS: reference columns reproduce Kimi K3's officially published numbers - the authors say they did not re-run them - so this is a same-table but cross-harness comparison. Two rows are losses (Terminal-Bench 2.1 86.5 vs 88.3, on a different agent harness than the base's official figure; MMMU-Pro 81.0 vs 81.6) and AutomationBench is a 0.2 pp margin. All numbers at reasoning effort 'max', temperature 1.0.
